findings.issue: Legacy project installation could activate a second plugin when the default user plugin remained loaded alongside a custom configuration directory.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Legacy installation checks all loaded user directories and refuses duplicate activation.

findings.issue: A migrated global plugin could accept a binding and suppress publication when OpenCode also loaded an empty custom configuration directory.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Worker activation recognizes the existing owned plugin across both loaded directories.

findings.issue: Review questioned whether resuming a session from another checkout could route ID-only events through that checkout.
findings.disposition: Refuted for the supported 1.19.5 interface. All eleven observed callbacks reached the original worktree instance after the real session resumed from a disabled sibling.
